title: Mystic Portal Ritual
description: A hooded figure with glowing purple eyes holds a melting green candle that drips wax and emits colorful smoke streams containing musical notes. Behind the figure is a large circular metal portal showing two old sailing ships on a purple sea under an orange sunset, with a cracked moon containing a green-eyed alien skull above it.
prompt: A hooded figure in a blue cloak with glowing purple eyes stands in the foreground holding a large melting green candle that drips wax and emits colorful swirling smoke trails with musical notes. Behind him is a large circular metal porthole-like portal revealing two old sailing ships on a purple ocean at sunset, with keys hanging from the frame and green slime dripping from the top. Above the portal floats a cracked white moon with a large alien skull with glowing green eyes breaking through it, in a surreal dark fantasy style with dramatic lighting.
